correctness.rationale: The flow formula x_i(t)=u_i E_i(s,t)/(1+sum_j u_j int_s^t b_j(v)E_j(s,v)dv) follows by direct differentiation, including pulse end-point convention. Exact projective composition L_(n,d) o L_(m,c)=L_(n*m,c+m*d) yields strictly positive c_j, pulse-time-independent mu_i, and the geometric-series iterate for every k. The three cases max mu>1, =1 and <1 follow by dividing the common denominator by max(mu)^k, by k, or using convergence of geometric series. Active ratios force common multipliers for cycles; the scalar increasing Beverton-Holt map rules out nonfixed cycles. At maximizing fixed simplex the Jacobian has tangent 1, radial 1/Lambda and transverse mu_j/Lambda; this is normal attraction, not isolated asymptotic stability. Negative or zero initial populations are not included in global selection; fixed-face classification includes nonnegative supports. Independent exact-rational flow/pulse witness gave multiplier vector (2,3), c=(7/4,3/2); shifted timing gives c_2=5/2 and winner abundance 4/5 rather than 4/3. Finite corroboration is not the proof.
